name: a-cramped-window-is-opened-out
find: guard frame.width < crampedWidth else { return frame }
breaks: a window macOS restored at a cramped width stays cramped, so PostRoll opens into a sliver of the screen and every screen inside it is judged at a width the app was never meant to be used at. Until #1335 this rule was computed inline against NSScreen.main, which is why it had no test either way: a decision read off a global at the point of use cannot be driven (L196)
